limitations: Inverse-volatility weighting (1 / sqrt(v_i)) capped at 40% does not optimize cross-asset covariance; low-volatility IEF sits near the 40% cap (~38.5-39.7%), reducing volatility and drawdown but lagging equal-weight during strong equity/gold rallies.
Historical 2016-2026 data was previously inspected in SPY/AAPL and 2020 foundation runs; results are exploratory historical evidence, not a pristine unseen holdout.
Any underperformance in Phase 5 stress scenarios is a relative failure within the synchronized circular block-bootstrap family, not a prediction of future market paths.
